source: docs/design/parts-brief-2026-09-18.md section 2.16, "IMPACT METER, ROW VARIANT (revised 2026-09-18)", superseding this file's own prior audit-derived values (docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/AUDIT-2026-09-07.md items B29-B46) for the row variant only; the full variant's source there is unchanged.
notes: Row variant, rewritten 2026-09-18 (lane w10a): the brief replaced the OLD per-dimension model (four scored dimensions, sorted ascending, each its own height/colour) with a STEPPED FILL OF THE TOTAL N/12. Four bars at fixed heights 6/9/12/15px, 8px wide, gap 2, radius 1.5, on an unfilled track #E5E1DB. Each bar holds 3 of the 12 points and fills bottom-up: fill_i = clamp(N - 3*i, 0, 3) / 3. ALL filled bars share ONE colour, read off the severity ramp at N (linear interpolation between 1 #16A34A, 4 #CA8A04, 7 #F97316, 12 #DC2626), never a per-bar colour, the brief's own acceptance test is that two rows with the same N render byte-identical markup regardless of dimension composition (asserted at the source level by src/components/ui/ImpactMeter.npmtest.mjs, not only here).

Row-scored fixture (sum 7/12, dims cost:1 compliance:1 client:2 operational:3, mounts.mjs's own pre-existing vector, still valid under the new model): fill_0=1 (bar1 full, 6px), fill_1=1 (bar2 full, 9px), fill_2=1/3 (bar3, 12*1/3=4px), fill_3=0 (bar4, 0px); colour = rampColor(7) = #F97316.

Row-partial fixture (sum 2/12, dims cost:0 compliance:0 client:0 operational:2): REPURPOSED from the retired per-dimension model's own "[0,0,0,2], never one lonely bar" fixture (lane METERFIX, 2026-09-08, superseded), the same dimension vector is kept because it still demonstrates the NEW model's partial-fill case: fill_0=2/3 (bar1, 6*2/3=4px), fill_1..3=0; colour = rampColor(2) = #529B33.

Row-unscored: the brief's own words, "the same four bars as 1px dashed rgba(0,0,0,.3) outlines, no fill, and an em dash in the score slot. No word." No baseline element any more (the retired model's single 30px dashed line, `.cl-impact-baseline`, is gone from the row variant; it survives only in the full variant's own unchanged unscored branch, which never carried the row's class name in the first place).

768px mobile geometry is NOT drawn by the brief; per the coordinator's ruling (lane w10a, 2026-09-18, recorded in the lane's report as a case not drawn) the row variant's geometry is unchanged at every width, so this mount carries no separate mobile capture and no @media rule exists in ImpactMeter.tsx to measure.

Full variant track: unchanged by this brief. height:8px, border-radius:8px, background linear-gradient(90deg,#16A34A,#F97316 55%,#DC2626), label column 116px, bar column flex, value column 64px right-aligned tabular-nums 12.5px. The fixture's four scores (cost:1, compliance:3, client:1, operational:2) are unchanged from before this lane.

Full variant, unscored: unchanged by this brief, the 96px dashed baseline (`width: variant === "full" ? 96 : 30` in the pre-2026-09-18 source; the row variant's own unscored branch no longer uses that ternary at all, having moved to the four-bar treatment above, but the full branch keeps its literal 96 unchanged).
